bank_irvine.name: Bank Irvine
bank_irvine.verify_note: AA read from the FDIC PE by research agent 2026-08-22 — Matthew must re-read the PE and flip verified:true before any send. Branch list check on bankirvine.com also required (PE is from 10/2024).
bank_irvine.pe_giving: SMALL BANK procedures — streamlined lending test only; CD activity is OPTIONAL and counts only toward an Outstanding. NTI is a lending-distribution failure ('very poor' geographic distribution), which a grant does not fix. Weakest structural fit of the eight despite the strongest pressure signal; pitch as sponsorship, expect a long shot.

hanmi_bank.name: Hanmi Bank
hanmi_bank.aa_note: (California assessment areas only; Hanmi's TX/IL/NJ-NY/VA assessment areas are outside this document's scope)
hanmi_bank.verify_note: CA counties from PE p.12 (agent-read 2026-08-22): LA+Orange full-scope + SD/SF/Santa Clara limited-scope, all whole counties. Multi-state bank; document covers CA only. Prior PE (2021) was Needs to Improve. FDIC Q3 2026 exam window.
hanmi_bank.pe_giving: Large Bank — Investment Test = Low Satisfactory, 'rarely in a leadership position.' Bank-wide grants only 36 totaling $346,000 on a $6B deposit base — smallest philanthropic footprint of the set, and DECLINING (LA giving fell from $519,840/52 grants to $281,080/14). LARGEST DISCLOSED GRANT ANYWHERE IN THE PE IS $15,000 — that is the ceiling. 3,496 CD service hours, 3,116 in Community Services.

five_star_bank.name: Five Star Bank
five_star_bank.verify_note: From PE p.4 (agent-read 2026-08-22): Sacramento AA (El Dorado, Placer, Sacramento, Yolo, Yuba, Sutter) + Chico AA (Butte) + Redding AA (Shasta, limited-scope). FDIC Q4 2026 exam.
five_star_bank.pe_giving: Large Bank — Investment Test = High Satisfactory ('excellent' in Sacramento AA); outperformed similarly situated institutions. 195 donations totaling $1.27M, including a single $900,000 gift to a school where 97% qualify for free/reduced lunch. Service Test = Low Satisfactory (no branch in a low-income tract). PRECEDENT WORTH CITING: examiners called a bank-funded contract counselor providing free counseling 'especially innovative' — direct support for funding paid navigator capacity rather than employee volunteering.
five_star_bank.pe_need_quote: poverty and homelessness, unemployment, and a lack of knowledge for financial resources … more can be done to meet economic needs

bank_of_marin.name: Bank of Marin
bank_of_marin.aa_note: (Alameda County, a partial-county assessment area in the bank's PE, is excluded from all figures — county-level data would overstate a tract-defined area)
bank_of_marin.verify_note: From PE p.4 (agent-read 2026-08-22). CERT is 32779 (NOT 21956 = Montecito Bank & Trust). Alameda is PARTIAL (10-mile-radius tracts), deliberately EXCLUDED (conservative). Formal annual grant program. FDIC Q3 2026 exam.
bank_of_marin.pe_giving: Large Bank — Low Satisfactory on ALL THREE tests. 436 grants totaling $1.58M but averaging only ~$3,600; largest disclosed is $10,000/yr to a workforce development program. Entire $46.1M investment book is affordable-housing MBS — ZERO community-services investments, so every non-housing dollar came through the grant line. CD service hours fell 17% and are 'below the ratio range of similarly situated institutions.' Amador AA: zero grants, zero services, zero investments.
bank_of_marin.pe_need_quote: CD opportunities exist in the AA with … business technical assistance, and financial literacy education

american_business_bank.name: American Business Bank
american_business_bank.verify_note: From PE p.4 (agent-read 2026-08-22): four whole counties (LA CSA). NOT a designated wholesale bank — Large Institution procedures; one full-service branch + LPOs. FDIC Q4 2026 exam.
american_business_bank.pe_giving: Large Bank — Investment Test = High Satisfactory. 258 grants totaling $1.64M, UP 185.7% by dollar from the prior exam and 'doubled the grants at one comparable bank and tripled the grants at the other.' Demonstrated six-figure single-grantee capacity: $458,000 combined to one CDC. Employees provided free income tax preparation for low-income families — the closest analogue in the set to benefits-application assistance. Highest realistic ask of the eight.
american_business_bank.pe_need_quote: the need for affordable housing as well as community service needs

helm_bank.name: Helm Bank USA
helm_bank.aa_note: (Miami AA: Miami-Dade/Broward/Palm Beach; Orlando AA created February 2025 — not yet examined, and will be evaluated for the first time at the next examination)
helm_bank.verify_note: AAs verbatim from PE p.3 (agent-read 8/22). NTI rating; Q4 2026 re-exam; Credicorp acquisition pending Fed approval — quadruple signal. Orlando AA unexamined = clean-slate opportunity framing.
helm_bank.pe_giving: ISB — Community Development Test (not an Investment Test). Entire grant program over the 3.2-yr period: 19 donations totaling $25,161 (~$1,300 avg); 18 of 19 were Community Services. CD services 16, 'below the performance of similarly situated institutions.' NTI is driven by the LENDING test ('strategy of lending to affluent non-resident aliens'), not by CD — CD Test was Satisfactory. ASK THE SPONSOR TIER: $30K would exceed their entire historical giving.
helm_bank.pe_need_quote: a significant need for … financial literacy education to low- and moderate-income individuals

banco_do_brasil_americas.name: Banco do Brasil Americas
banco_do_brasil_americas.aa_note: (Miami AA: Miami-Dade/Broward; Orlando AA: Orange/Osceola — both full-scope in the 5/2025 evaluation)
banco_do_brasil_americas.verify_note: AAs verbatim from PE p.4 (agent-read 8/22). THIRD consecutive NTI; Q3 2026 accelerated re-exam. No Palm Beach.
banco_do_brasil_americas.pe_giving: Large Bank — Investment Test = High Satisfactory. 60 donations totaling $246,765 (~$4,100 avg), up 6.3x from $39,000 at the prior exam. Miami AA: 44 donations / $117,000. CLOSEST PEER GRANTS IN THE SET: six donations totaling $20,500 to a nonprofit providing 'crisis care, food and household subsidy, and employment training'; five totaling $10,000 to one providing 'emergency food and shelter, rent and utility assistance, and financial literacy education.' Orlando AA had ONE CD service all period.
banco_do_brasil_americas.pe_need_quote: a significant need for … financial literacy education to low- and moderate-income individuals

ocean_bank.name: Ocean Bank
ocean_bank.aa_note: (Miami-Dade and Broward AAs full-scope in the 6/2023 evaluation; Orange County AA added May 2023 and will be evaluated for the first time at the upcoming examination)
ocean_bank.verify_note: AAs from PE p.4 (agent-read 8/22). Satisfactory rating; Q3 2026 exam scheduled — largest independent FL community bank.
ocean_bank.pe_giving: Large Bank — Investment Test = Low Satisfactory, 'adequate... although rarely in a leadership position'; volume 'below four similarly situated banks'; services 'below all but one institution.' 42 grants totaling $492,000 (~$11,700 avg); one $100,000 gift to an education org. 29 of 42 grants (84% of grant dollars) are Community Services. THE OPENING: the Fort Lauderdale/Broward AA received ZERO grants and ZERO CD services benefiting only that AA.
ocean_bank.pe_need_quote: the high percentage of low- and moderate-income families, at 39.6 percent, and the poverty rate indicate needs for financial literacy
